title: ArcCivs Auto2 gate flank normal WALL infill
assumptions: One requested existing Auto2 flank gap, six columns, exactly once. Low/base/high all represent that one known repair; repeated deterministic piece ID cannot issue another wall. This is not a recurring earning flow.

Raw structural candidate from the existing normal wall recipe is26STONE_BRICKS and2DARK_OAK_FENCE. This is the source-derived structural bill; fresh native admission determines any additional ordinary approach/foundation material and the complete exact paid bill before apply. No new rate or free wall path is introduced.

The new WALL uses existing infrastructure capture, immutable plan and queued paid construction. Current construction and old gate/wall captures remain intact. A preview does not admit, pay or build anything. Native path/owner/height/occupancy guards still decide admission.

Direct currency and player XP remain separately0Vault,0premiumtokens,0playerXP. Physical materials and legacy Stock are alternative normal accounting modes; current Auto2 isPHYSICAL. No item grant, refund, free drops, world edit or forced builder arrival is allowed.
Current SELL/AutoSell and planned SELL-to-contract remain separate. No item-to-money conversion or production throughput is inferred.
